tools.name: set_properties
tools.why: Figma makes the change and saves it, so the result is `{ id, set }` with no `unsaved_edits`, and one call is one undo step there. Not built there yet, each refused by name with nothing changed: componentPropertyReferences, reactions and the other prototype keys, an image by path (give its imageHash), and Slides' and FigJam's keys. Figma drops the own opacity of a paint bound to a variable when it resolves the paint again for another mode (explicitVariableModes on the layer or a parent): for a translucent token, give the variable a colour with alpha
